text_block_list.text:
"Hawawawa!? What, what!? What was that 
just now...!?"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
...Whoa, my chest suddenly feels all warm 
and burning...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
It feels like power is overflowing inside 
me!
